title: Missing decisive scope attestation

injection.description: All baseline gates pass. The single decisive query-scope field query_rule_hash is removed from the collector attestation; the completeness flag, collector version, extracted signals and the inventory digest remain. The missing field must not be normalized into an empty set or a PASS.

required_evidence: the missing query-scope field recorded as unavailable; completeness flag and collector version retained
extracted signals and inventory digest retained
P1 OPEN with evidence_status NFI and A1_SCOPE_NOT_ATTESTED
no invented empty-set or default-pass value
